sections.heading: Summary
body: Traffic grew 12% month on month, driven almost entirely by the checkout API following the February pricing launch. Latency improved despite the extra load, thanks to the connection-pool change shipped on the 8th.
One incident affected search for 41 minutes on 19 February. Root cause was an unbounded query introduced by a third-party integration; a query timeout has since been added.

sections.heading: Actions for next month
body: Reporting remains the slowest service at a p95 of 884 ms. The team will move its aggregate queries onto the read replica and revisit the index on the events table.
Error rate rose slightly, entirely within the webhooks service. The retry policy will be changed from fixed to exponential backoff.
